info.title: CF Meet Telephony internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/telephony (Part E §165–§172): GET /health and the provider callback ingress (public, provider-authenticated before parsing, 16 KiB limit) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API used by Calling only. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token; customer credentials, cfmk_ keys and Authorization headers are refused. Telephony -> Calling delivery is the durable outbox (cfmeet.telephony.event to Calling's POST /internal/v1/telephony/events). Metrics are served on a separate listener, never here.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Telephony's trust bundle.

Readiness.description: Counts and normalized states only (no provider names, no credentials).

platform.common.v1.CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContactReference.description: Opaque, server-generated ContactReference (UUID) of a protected contact, scoped to one tenant / application / environment. It never encodes a number, country, provider or user; knowing it grants nothing.

mediaJoinCode.description: APPLICATION_MEDIA only: the single-use code the application media side presents at the edge.

telephony.commands.v1.ControlCommand.description: POST /internal/v1/legs/{id}/terminate | hold | resume | answer | prompt | capture | capture-stop. Part F: answer, prompt, capture and capture-stop act on internal enterprise SIP legs only (permission telephony-leg.media); prompt requires `prompt`, capture and capture-stop require `capture` (a call RECORDING records the leg's bridge when bridged).

prompt.description: Part F, PROMPT only: one BUILT-IN prompt of Calling's catalog. Telephony maps it to an edge-local sound; Calling never names a sound file, URL or path.

capture.description: Part F, CAPTURE only: capture the leg's caller audio into the edge's TRANSIENT spool for delivery to Calling (captureId is Calling's message / recording id). Never an object-storage key, a bucket, a URL or a file path: Telephony names its own spool file.

maxDurationSeconds.description: VOICEMAIL at most 600, RECORDING at most 1440.

telephony.commands.v1.Error.description: Telephony error envelope: a bounded code and a fixed message. Never a provider message, SIP response or number.

telephony.commands.v1.LegAccepted.description: 202 (accepted for execution) or 200 with replayed=true (an identical earlier command).

telephony.commands.v1.LegView.description: A Telephony leg as Calling sees it: CF Meet ids, normalized status and timestamps. Never a provider, route identity, SIP data or number.

telephony.commands.v1.OriginateCommand.description: POST /internal/v1/legs/originate. No number, no provider. The caller identity is selected server-side: the session's relay identity, or (Part IV L) a Digital Communications Number presented ONLY under Numbering's single-use CALLER_IDENTITY grant for exactly this origination (operation leg:{callLegId}:{commandId}), which Telephony consumes before transmission and presents only on an interconnect the DCN is bound to.

scope.description: Must equal the signed delegated platform context.

authorization.description: Authorization evidence (Calling + Privacy Relay). Telephony verifies shape, scope and freshness; it never decides.

destination.description: The protected destination: an opaque ContactReference and a grant — never a number.

grantSecret.description: Single-use Contact Resolution Grant secret (fresh per submission; never stored by Calling).

candidateRoutes.description: Ordered opaque route references from the Routing Engine (Telephony narrows them).

presentedIdentity.description: Part IV L: the DCN to present (CF Meet Number Resource id — never the number) and Numbering's bearer grant (stored until transmission only, never logged, excluded from the request digest).

interconnectClass.description: The interconnect class Calling's route policy selected (default PUBLIC). SYNTHETIC_TEST requires presentedIdentity and uses synthetic test routes only.

telephony.common.v1.FailureCategory.description: The same vocabulary as Calling's failure categories.

telephony.common.v1.InterconnectClass.description: What a Telephony route connects to (Part IV L closure): PUBLIC, a real interconnect; SYNTHETIC_TEST, a local synthetic test interconnect (loopback SIP edge, simulated carrier, zero cost) that carries synthetic DCNs only, in local / test runtimes only.

telephony.common.v1.PublicRouteClass.description: Public-network route classes Telephony executes (Calling's Routing Engine classes; APP_RTC never reaches Telephony). Part F: ENTERPRISE_INTERNAL is an internal dialog of an enterprise SIP device on CF Meet's own edge (no carrier, no provider, no spend, no usage fact).

telephony.common.v1.TelephonyLegStatus.description: Normalized status of a Telephony execution leg. UNKNOWN is not terminal and never a failure: the provider may or may not have created a paid call; only evidence resolves it.

telephony.routes.v1.title: CF Meet Telephony route availability v1
telephony.routes.v1.description: GET /internal/v1/routes/availability?country=&capability= (Part E §142–§150): the normalized, provider-neutral availability the Routing Engine ranks. A route is an opaque reference; health, capacity, cost estimate and quality are evidence (KNOWN with a value, or UNKNOWN — never invented). No provider name, carrier, trunk or number.

post.description: Provider event callback. Authenticated by the adapter (signature / token / peer) BEFORE parsing; bodies over 16 KiB are refused unread; a strict parser; dedupe by (provider, provider event id). The body is provider-specific (adapter-internal, not a CF Meet contract).

200.description: Recorded (applied, duplicate, stale, late or quarantined).

post.description: Provider callback for adapters that authenticate with a path token (compared in constant time).

Durable ORIGINATE (permission telephony-leg.originate). One provider effect per idempotency key; refused while another execution of the CallLeg, or of the same party of the Call, is live or UNKNOWN (409 EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS).
Idempotent termination (an unresolved one is reconciled until the provider confirms). Permission telephony-leg.terminate.

post.description: Part F: play one BUILT-IN prompt (body `prompt`) on an internal enterprise SIP leg; playbacks of a leg run in order. Permission telephony-leg.media.

200.description: Replay of an identical earlier command.

post.description: Part F: capture the caller audio of an internal enterprise SIP leg (body `capture`: Calling's capture id, purpose, maximum length, beep) into the edge's transient spool; on completion Telephony delivers it to Calling (cfmeet.telephony.capture) and then deletes the spool copy. Permission telephony-leg.media; refused (LEG_NOT_ACTIVE) for public-network legs and while ENTERPRISE_SIP_ENABLED is off.

200.description: Replay of an identical earlier command.

post.description: Part F: stop a running capture of an internal enterprise SIP leg early (body `capture`: the capture to stop) — a call recording's explicit / policy stop. The edge then delivers it like any finished capture. Never blocked by a kill switch; a capture that already finished makes it a no-op. Permission telephony-leg.media.
